# Button (`button`)

Primary, secondary, text and danger buttons in three sizes, with icon and loading states.

Group: Actions. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/actions';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createButton` (types in `dist/web/actions/button.d.ts`): `.mh-button` with `--primary | --secondary | --tonal | --text | --danger` and `--sm | --lg`; states `.is-loading` and `:disabled`. Height follows the theme's density, corners its control radius.

```ts
export function createButton(options: ButtonOptions): ButtonHandle;

export interface ButtonOptions {
  label: string;
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  trailingIcon?: IconName | string;
  loading?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  type?: 'button' | 'submit' | 'reset';
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
}

export interface ButtonHandle {
  el: HTMLButtonElement;
  setLabel(label: string): void;
  setLoading(loading: boolean): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createButton } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const button = createButton({
  label: 'Turn on',
  icon: 'power',
  variant: 'primary',
  onClick: () => {
    button.setLoading(true);
    setTimeout(() => button.setLoading(false), 800);
  },
});

document.body.append(button.el);
```

## React API

`Button` (types in `dist/react/actions.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createButton`.

```ts
export function Button({ variant, size, icon, trailingIcon, loading = false, fullWidth, disabled, className, type = 'button', children, ...rest }: ButtonProps);

export interface ButtonProps extends ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  trailingIcon?: IconName | string;
  loading?: boolean;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  children?: ReactNode;
}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function ButtonExample() {
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const turnOn = () => {
    setBusy(true);
    setTimeout(() => setBusy(false), 800);
  };
  return (
    <Button icon="power" variant="primary" loading={busy} onClick={turnOn}>
      Turn on
    </Button>
  );
}
```
